subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs gain a supported per-run provider/model override, and if so should the public contract be `payload.model`, top-level job fields, or an explicit `sessionOverride` block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes cron's public schema, session/provider precedence, persistence expectations, and upgrade semantics, so automation should not choose the API shape.

options.title: Add an explicit sessionOverride block
options.body: Introduce a dedicated cron override object for `provider` and `model` that is applied only to the cron-triggered main-session run and never persisted as the user's main session choice.

options.title: Extend systemEvent payload.model
options.body: Reuse the existing agent-turn field name on `systemEvent` payloads, keeping the API compact but overloading a payload kind that docs currently describe as text-only.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document isolated `agentTurn` cron jobs as the supported per-job model path and leave main-session system events tied to the target session model state.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit sessionOverride block
recommendation.body: Introduce a dedicated cron override object for `provider` and `model` that is applied only to the cron-triggered main-session run and never persisted as the user's main session choice.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron runtime, protocol, session-target, and documentation history makes this the best available owner for the product/API direction.
